name: CLI-Anything
description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
one_liner: A system that builds command-line controls for existing desktop software, like a music library app or a note-taking tool, so an AI agent can operate programs that were only ever built for humans to click through.
buyer: A developer or power user who wants their AI agent to automate a specific piece of software, such as a design app or e-book tool, that has no official API.
business_use_cases: A niche software vendor without a public API lets the community build a CLI wrapper for their tool, making it usable by AI-agent power users.
An automation consultant builds a one-off CLI for a client's legacy desktop software, then wires an agent to it to run nightly data exports automatically.
A contributor builds CLIs for popular creator tools and lists them on the CLI-Hub marketplace to build a public portfolio and reputation.

money_ideas.idea: Take paid contract work building a bespoke CLI wrapper for a company's internal legacy software so their AI agents can finally operate it.

steal_this: Pick one piece of software you use daily that has no API, build a CLI wrapper for it with this framework over a weekend, and submit it to CLI-Hub.
